title: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass that allows users with the read-only VIEWER role to…
description: SurrealDB versions 3.0.0 up to but not including 4.0.0 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows users assigned the read-only VIEWER role to modify the database schema by implicitly creating new tables without proper permission checks. Specifically, issuing CREATE statements on nonexistent tables in non-STRICT mode adds arbitrary empty schemaless tables, potentially cluttering the schema or causing conflicts with application tables.
